datasets.verbatim: The dataset is prepared using Sentinel-2 imageries resampled to 10 metres and ALOS-PALSAR derived topographical data.

methods.name: DvD algorithm
methods.summary: An empirical algorithm that identifies landslides by applying specific thresholds to a multiplicative combination of conditional NDVI, conditional BSI, and conditional slope layers, followed by an average filter.
methods.source: Meghanadh Devara, Vipin Kumar Maurya & Ramji Dwivedi
methods.verbatim: Therefore, the primary objective of the study is to propose a novel empirical algorithm, DvD, for rapid landslide identification...
